product_metadata.title: 2 Pack Microwave Food Covers, Microwave Covers for Food Collapsible Microwave Splatter Cover, 10.6" Microwave Covers Set with Tray (Black)
features: 【Microwave Covers for Food】Include plate cover and a tray that protects your microwave from splatters and spots. The tray has two handles, which can prevent scalding, allowing you to quickly take out the heated food. (××Can't put food directly on the tray and heat it up. The heating time cannot exceed 5 minutes)
【Collapsible Microwave Covers】Microwave plate cover made of high quality durable plastic and silicone, heat resistant up to 300℉ ( 149℃ ). Keep the microwave clean without washing. (Not Oven Safe)

【Microwave Plate Cover with Handles】The handle on the pop-up cover has a striped design, non-slip and easy to grab. Small holes in the top of the lid allow steam to escape, encouraging airflow to prevent condensation buildup.

【Silicone Microwave Splatter Cover 】10.6" L X 10.6" W X 3.8" H, when collapsed, 1.4" H. Interior of round is 10.5" diameter. Fits over most plates and bowls. It can easily be stored in any cabinet, cupboard, or drawer for easy storage.

【Microwave Safe Lid】Microwave food cover set can also be used as a food cover, fruit tray, and a fruit drainer basket. Suitable for use in kitchens, restaurants, parties, etc. And it's easy to clean. （Do NOT wash in the dishwasher）
